summary: Help the Wilson Family on their adventure by solving blast puzzles!
description:
Ready for a thrilling puzzle game experience? Wonder Blast invites you to an exciting journey, packed with blast puzzles that lead you to the magical theme park, Wonderville. Blast the cubes of the same color and create powerful boosters to solve the challenging puzzles. As you blast through colorful cubes, you'll help the Wilson Family who occasionally encounter danger during their mission to transform Wonderville into a wonderland, full of fun rides and attractions.

Join the Wilson family, a lively dad Willie, caring mom Betty, and their energetic kids Pixie & Roy, on this magical experience and have a blast!

Key Features of Wonder Blast:
- Thrilling Puzzles: Every level in this match 3 game presents a new blast puzzle for you to solve. Think you've got what it takes?
- Colorful cubes: Match the cubes of the same color to create a blast! Along the way, you'll encounter toy like obstacles that add to the fun.
- Powerful Boosters: Blast the cubes and make powerful boosters for huge explosions! Pop boosters and watch as they explode in a rainbow of colors.
- Theme Park Adventure: Help the Family build the best theme park ever, from Ferris wheel to the Rollercoaster. But watch out, danger lurks around every corner!
- Compete with Friends: This fun, free game lets you compete with players around the globe. 
- No Ads, No Wifi Needed: Enjoy this game anytime, anywhere - even without wifi. With no ads to interrupt your game, you're free to fully immerse in the fun.

Discover the mystery of Wonderville and engage with delightful toon characters Willie, Betty, Pixie, and Roy. They're counting on your help to save Wonderville. So, why wait? Your Adventure awaits in this fun, challenging game. Become a part of the Wilson Family's journey to create their star filled theme park. 

Ready for the ride? Start playing Wonder Blast, now!
